metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly composites: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG, bands: avg_rad (radiance), cf_cvg (cloud-free coverage).
- Time windows: April 2019 (2019-04-01 to 2019-05-01) and May 2019 (2019-05-01 to 2019-06-01), as a proxy for Apr 30–May 5.
- Locations: Biju Patnaik Airport (approx 20.252, 85.817) and Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691). Use 800 m buffer.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Monthly composites are cloud-screened. No extra masking. Use cf_cvg as a quality indicator.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If image collections for either month are empty: C1.
- If valid pixel count after mask for either site/month is 0: C2.
- If any mean is null/NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare decreases: (Apr - May) for each site. If Airport decrease > Saheed Nagar decrease => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const airportPt = ee.Geometry.Point([85.817, 20.252]);
    const saheedPt = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813]);
    const radius = 800; // meters
    const airportRegion = airportPt.buffer(radius).bounds();
    const saheedRegion = saheedPt.buffer(radius).bounds();

    const startApr = '2019-04-01';
    const startMay = '2019-05-01';
    const startJun = '2019-06-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const colId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG';
    const col = ee.ImageCollection(colId);

    const colApr = col.filterDate(startApr, startMay);
    const colMay = col.filterDate(startMay, startJun);

    const aprCount = await getInfoAsync(colApr.size());
    const mayCount = await getInfoAsync(colMay.size());
    console.log(`Monthly VCMSLCFG Images: Apr2019=${aprCount}, May2019=${mayCount}`);
    if (!aprCount || !mayCount) {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const imgApr = ee.Image(colApr.first());
    const imgMay = ee.Image(colMay.first());

    // Helper to compute stats for a region
    async function statsFor(image, region) {
      const countDict = image.select(['avg_rad'])
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        });
      const meanDict = image.select(['avg_rad'])
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        });
      const cfDict = image.select(['cf_cvg'])
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: region,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        });

      const count = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('avg_rad'));
      const mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('avg_rad'));
      const cfMean = await getInfoAsync(cfDict.get('cf_cvg'));
      return { count: count || 0, mean, cfMean };
    }

    // 3. Processing & Pixel Count Checks
    const aApr = await statsFor(imgApr, airportRegion);
    const aMay = await statsFor(imgMay, airportRegion);
    const sApr = await statsFor(imgApr, saheedRegion);
    const sMay = await statsFor(imgMay, saheedRegion);

    console.log(`Airport coords: [85.817, 20.252], buffer=800m`);
    console.log(`Saheed Nagar coords: [85.848691, 20.290813], buffer=800m`);

    console.log(`Airport Apr: mean(avg_rad)=${aApr.mean}, px=${aApr.count}, cf_cvg(mean)=${aApr.cfMean}`);
    console.log(`Airport May: mean(avg_rad)=${aMay.mean}, px=${aMay.count}, cf_cvg(mean)=${aMay.cfMean}`);
    console.log(`Saheed Apr: mean(avg_rad)=${sApr.mean}, px=${sApr.count}, cf_cvg(mean)=${sApr.cfMean}`);
    console.log(`Saheed May: mean(avg_rad)=${sMay.mean}, px=${sMay.count}, cf_cvg(mean)=${sMay.cfMean}`);

    if (aApr.count === 0 || aMay.count === 0 || sApr.count === 0 || sMay.count === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const vals = [aApr.mean, aMay.mean, sApr.mean, sMay.mean];
    const invalid = vals.some(v => v === null || v === undefined || !Number.isFinite(v));
    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const airportDecrease = aApr.mean - aMay.mean;
    const saheedDecrease = sApr.mean - sMay.mean;

    console.log(`Airport decrease (Apr-May): ${airportDecrease}`);
    console.log(`Saheed decrease (Apr-May): ${saheedDecrease}`);
    console.log(`Delta(decrease Airport - Saheed): ${airportDecrease - saheedDecrease}`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // If Airport decrease > Saheed decrease => A (Yes), else B (No)
    const answer = airportDecrease > saheedDecrease ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);

  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
